decisions.reason: As an upgraded successor to an already well-liked trommel screen, this product looks like a low-uncertainty extension of the core range whose option value has largely resolved positively, so a mature German machinery firm would likely keep it.

The firm’s 2019 rollout of EU Stage V technology across all models signals continued commitment to this mobile shredder line, and in real-options terms the line still offers enough strategic upside in the core mobile processing business to justify keeping it.

The move from a website mention in 2018 to a dedicated page in 2019 suggests improving confidence and market positioning, so the firm would likely retain this grinder line because its prospects remain attractive relative to its carrying cost.

This stationary pre-shredder line is closely aligned with the firm’s recycling-solutions strategy and was presented as setting a benchmark with identifiable use cases, so management would likely keep it because the option appears to be paying off rather than failing.
